Your family's water quality starts with the right treatment strategy.

Whether the source is municipal or private borehole supply, we configure purification systems around the actual contaminants, the required output, and the day-to-day convenience expected in a home environment.

  • Tap-water filtration for sediment, chlorine, taste, and odor control.
  • Domestic RO for borehole and well water with staged purification.
  • Replacement filters, UV parts, fittings, storage tanks, and service accessories.

Municipal and Tap Water Purification

From compact under-sink units to whole-house systems, these configurations improve everyday water quality without overcomplicating maintenance.

Single Stage Filtration

Compact filtration using sediment or carbon options for first-level improvement of tap water quality.

Double Stage Filtration

A staged combination of sediment and carbon filtration for stronger removal of particles, chlorine, and odor.

Triple Stage Filtration

Three-stage purification for more complete treatment of suspended matter, chlorine, and taste issues.

Triple Stage with UV

Adds UV sterilization to a staged filtration layout for microbiological safety without chemical dosing.

Whole-House RO Purification

A higher-purity domestic system using RO membrane treatment with optional polishing and UV stages.

Borehole and Well Water Purification

For groundwater sources, we move beyond simple cartridge filtration and use reverse osmosis-based configurations that can handle dissolved contaminants as well as physical impurities.

Under-Sink RO Unit (100 GPD)

A compact domestic RO system with sediment, carbon, membrane, storage, polishing, and optional UV stages.

Whole-House RO Purifier (400 GPD)

A larger domestic solution for full-home borehole water purification with higher output and integrated monitoring.
